sourceText:
Pasta Con Verdura
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 6, 2009 - 12:23am

Ingredients




1 cup Small broccoli florets
1 small Zucchini, sliced
1 small Sweet red pepper, cut in strips
1/2 cup Snow peas
1/4 cup Butter, unsalted preferably
1 cup 10%% cream, warmed
Freshly ground black pepper
1 pound Spaghetti, cooked & drained
Parmesan cheese, grated

Preparation

1 In a large skillet, saute broccoli, zucchini, red pepper and snow peas in butter until crisp tender. Add cream and black pepper. Cook briefly until slightly reduced. Mix with pasta and sprinkle with Parmesan. 2 Yield: 4servings.
